column4: swarm-chain-a: tex 1341 (sec:chain-core); the "can" is witnessed over F_2 for every nonempty compact metrizable zero-dimensional X: Rad_MF(GL_n, n>=3) and Rad_MF(EL_n, n>=4) equal EL_n(R_X,I), and the defect ideal I equals the transient ideal and is proper over every finite field

swarm-chain-a: tex 1439-1441 (proof of lem:chain-core-models); the oneBlock images of the itinerary cores decrease and each has the cycle condition; their intersection is pi_m(Y_*) and has the cycle condition
swarm-chain-a: tex 1489 (proof of lem:transient-matrices); a compact C outside CR(T) is covered by m clopen wandering sets, so every orbit meets C in at most m points

swarm-chain-a: tex 1489-1502 (proof of lem:transient-matrices); given a wandering cover of size m, loop erasure turns any shift path in C into an injective path with the same endpoint and at most m-1 steps

swarm-chain-a: tex 1502 (proof of lem:transient-matrices); for clopen C disjoint from CR(T): an orbit bound m, no fixed points of the nonidentity class shifts, and a finite clopen partition (locally constant atom : X -> Fin N) separating distinct points of each class
swarm-chain-a: tex 1502 (proof of lem:transient-matrices); every x in C has exactly one reachable exponent d with T^d x in C and atom minimal over its class
swarm-chain-a: tex 1502 (proof of lem:transient-matrices); the representative set and its complement in C are clopen, and the complement is the set of points whose class has a strictly smaller atom

swarm-chain-a: tex 1502 (proof of lem:transient-matrices); finitely many pairwise disjoint clopen cells cover the representative set, and on each cell R, atom o T^d and coeff o T^d are constant; the coefficients are passed as one locally constant map coeff : X -> Z
